'''2013 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Allen Gamble LS Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Allen Gamble]] at [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
